cases.name: Windows atomic write preserves a raw-file hardlink at the old temp name
cases.baseline_outcome: Raw sentinel bytes changed to the new manifest JSON; manifest identity matched the raw file and the existing alias disappeared.

cases.name: Windows atomic publication failure preserves a prior-target temp hardlink
cases.baseline_outcome: Prior revision 1 bytes changed to revision 2. The held target opened successfully, but the original writer returned published=true with an empty error. The alias disappeared.

cases.name: Windows atomic write preserves an ordinary file at the old temp name
cases.baseline_outcome: The existing ordinary sibling path disappeared; its original file identity was reused as the manifest.

cases.name: Windows atomic write preserves a raw-file symlink at the old temp name
cases.baseline_outcome: CreateSymbolicLinkW succeeded with error 0. Raw sentinel bytes changed to the new manifest JSON, and the published manifest was itself a symlink to that raw file.

python.skip_reason: All six explicit skips are daemon-not-built cases in the separate Python job.

indices.scope: Every actual CTest row is retained; the index never declares corruption automatically.

The one regex separator was relaxed, the initial rejected index was retained, and six negative parser controls passed again. Manual failure expansion review established the defect separately.
